name: supern
description: Local-first browser productivity tools: time blocks, tab actions, video controls, and more.

scripts.dev: web-ext run --firefox-profile .dev-profile --keep-profile-changes --profile-create-if-missing --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json amo-metadata.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts dist .dev-profile scripts background-chrome.js CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md README.md RELEASE.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md TODO.md TODO. dev .claude .env icons/preview.html icons/block-n-preview.html
scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename supern.xpi --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json amo-metadata.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts dist .dev-profile scripts background-chrome.js CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md README.md RELEASE.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md TODO.md TODO. dev .claude .env icons/preview.html icons/block-n-preview.html
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist --filename supern-chrome.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run package:chrome && web-ext lint --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json amo-metadata.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts dist .dev-profile scripts background-chrome.js CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md README.md RELEASE.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md TODO.md TODO. dev .claude .env icons/preview.html icons/block-n-preview.html
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel=listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --api-key=$AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret=$AMO_JWT_SECRET --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json amo-metadata.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts dist .dev-profile scripts background-chrome.js CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md README.md RELEASE.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md TODO.md TODO. dev .claude .env icons/preview.html icons/block-n-preview.html
scripts.sign:unlisted: web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --api-key=$AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret=$AMO_JWT_SECRET --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json amo-metadata.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts dist .dev-profile scripts background-chrome.js CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md README.md RELEASE.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md TODO.md TODO. dev .claude .env icons/preview.html icons/block-n-preview.html
scripts.install-local: npm run build && npm run install-ext
